description: Schema for an event in the history model.

id.description: The unique identifier of the event.

start.description: The start epoch timestamp of the event.

end.description: The end epoch timestamp of the event.

tentative.description: Whether the event is tentative (not yet confirmed).

entity.description: The user associated with the event.

data.description: Additional data specific to the event type. The structure of this can be retrieved using getEventTypeSchema.
